card.name: Quantum information: fixed-depth QAOA parameter design

task.name: Quantum information: fixed-depth QAOA parameter design
task.description: Design graph-dependent two-layer QAOA angles maximizing the mean ratio of the independently simulated expected cut to the exact classical optimum on six small graphs. The circuit architecture is fixed; the candidate controls its parameter-selection algorithm.
task.contract: angles(n, edges, p) -> real array (p, 2), rows (gamma, beta) in radians. The fixed circuit starts in |+>^n and applies exp(-i gamma C), then exp(-i beta sum X), for each row; C is unweighted MaxCut. Return angles only. Six public evaluation graphs use n=6,8,10 and densities 0.25,0.55 (seed 713); use graph_cases(seed=113) for separate development graphs. Objective: mean expected-cut/exhaustive-optimum ratio. p=2; no shot noise or timing term.
